record.question: The Guidelines for Inner Line Pass (ILP) are issued under which law?
record.explanation: Answer A: Bengal Eastern Frontier Regulation, 1873. The Inner Line permit system is rooted in the Bengal Eastern Frontier Regulation, 1873. Reference: https://www.indiacode.nic.in/handle/123456789/2267. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
